summary: Iteration 16 - AssetList-driven Pre Service Check templates: backend 100% pass (all new-feature endpoints), frontend Irrigator + Generic flows both work end-to-end. Regression suites also pass (except 3 pre-existing sync_idempotency flaky tests unrelated to new feature).

minor.issue: Response JSON includes `make: null` field on templates. Not a bug per se but the field is redundant now that templates are keyed by check_type; consider removing from ServiceCheckTemplate serialization to avoid confusion.

Pre-existing failures in test_sync_idempotency.py test_01_upload_with_extra_row (expects added>=1 but got 0 because a prior test-run soft-deleted TEST_Sync Person still exists and is only 'updated/un-retired' instead of 'added'). Same for asset test_01. This is legacy test flakiness caused by test data leaked by earlier iterations, NOT a new-feature bug.

ui_bugs.issue: When user rapidly changes 'Machine Make' and immediately opens 'Machine Name' before fetchNames() resolves, the stale previous list can still be shown and a stale name selection maps to a machine of the previous make (observed: after Perrot, selecting JCB then quickly picking name[0] returned a Bauer machine). Add loading state / disable name select until names refresh.

Modal textarea and 'Record Fault' button have no data-testid, making automated testing brittle. Also this modal is not [role=dialog]. Add data-testid='fault-explanation-textarea' and data-testid='fault-record-btn'.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid to Fault Explanation Modal textarea + Record Fault button
(Optional) Disable Machine Name select or clear its combobox display until fetchNames() resolves to prevent stale selection after fast make switching
(Optional) Remove redundant `make: null` field from ServiceCheckTemplate serialization
critical_code_review_comments: NewChecklist.js is 1675 lines - consider splitting the Fault Modal, Add Machine Modal, and the daily/pre-service/fuel step-3 forms into separate components (>700 line threshold).
fetchServiceTemplate silently falls back to GENERIC_SERVICE_TEMPLATE on network error - error is only logged; user has no signal. A subtle toast would be useful.

sync_idempotency.py tests are stateful and require a clean DB baseline every run; consider a proper setup fixture that first ensures the TEST_ rows are gone (upload baseline once) before the additive test.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 new + 63/66 regression; 3 sync_idempotency failures are pre-existing state issues)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (Irrigator PSC full flow, Generic PSC full flow, Admin Template Diagnostics, /all-checks?view=servicing)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed pre_service_check records (Perrot Machine 1 / Bauer P16 / JCB TEST_Fastrac 4220 / Bowser 1000l) via backend + frontend flows. All contain TEST_ prefix in notes/parts. No DELETE endpoint exists so records remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://core-checks-only.preview.emergentagent.com. AssetList2.xlsx already uploaded (idempotent). One Irrigator service template (13 sections, 92 assets). Fault Modal has no data-testid (use placeholder='Describe the issue and any immediate actions taken...' to target the textarea and get_by_role('button', name='Record Fault') for the button). Machine Name select must be given ~1.5-2s to refresh after make change or you can accidentally pick a stale machine from previous make. shadcn Selects use button[role=combobox]; not all data-testid on the Select root reaches the combobox button.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature implemented correctly. The 3 sync_idempotency failures RCA: previous test runs added 'TEST_Sync Person' (staff) and 'TEST_Sync Machine' (asset), then soft-deleted/retired them. The test's first upload expects added>=1 but soft-deleted rows are un-retired (updated) instead of newly added, so added=0. Mitigation: modify the test to first hard-remove or accept `added>=1 OR updated>=1`.
